workflow: Prepared for public link sharing at user request. No customer communication.

references.title: Scroll slider for blink
references.author: Edo Lunardi, design by seb__design
references.use: Scroll-bound storytelling and flat surfaces. Reference easing inferred as cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); recording camera zoom is excluded. No reference numbers or claims transferred.

references.title: Office Commun brand + motion
references.author: Drice
references.use: Sparse composition and clear resting states. Analysis found hard cuts, so no invented animation parameters are attributed to this reference.

components.adaptation: Pinned stage, expansion by scroll progress, full size at 85%, side text fading by 40%. Uses native browser scrolling rather than an Expo dependency.

Original pull/snap spring stiffness, damping and mass; strength .35 and contentStrength .18. Fine-pointer only; native HTML links and buttons preserve keyboard interaction. Reduced motion disables springs.

imagery: Existing locally generated concept assets retained. Not official product photography.
content: Existing manufacturer name and external catalogue/contact destinations retained. Removed cherry state that reused a tinted currant image. No prices, testimonials, nutrition or production claims added. Flavour descriptions remain concept copy pending approval.
motion: No automatic carousel or decorative infinite loops. Scroll-driven layer separation, macro reveal and on-demand flavour image wipe. Reduced-motion preference disables transitions and reveals the texture directly.

passed: no horizontal overflow at checked widths
reduced-motion static layout and immediate flavour switching
runtime reduced-motion preference change without reload
no browser console errors in final revision
